args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Documents:
- Passport/ID
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Travel insurance documents
- Credit cards and cash
- Emergency contact information

Beach & Water Activities (Waikiki Beach, Hanauma Bay, Kailua Beach):
- Swimsuits (at least 2-3)
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Sunglasses with UV protection
- Wide-brimmed hat
- Beach bag
- Flip-flops/sandals
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Waterproof phone case
- Rash guard/swim shirt for sun protection
- Water shoes

Hiking (Diamond Head):
- Sturdy hiking shoes
- Lightweight, moisture-wicking clothing
- Hiking socks
- Daypack/backpack
- Reusable water bottle
- Trail snacks
- Sunscreen
- Hat
- Light rain jacket (weather can change quickly)

Sightseeing (Pearl Harbor, North Shore, Polynesian Cultural Center):
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable fabrics)
- Light sweater or jacket for evenings
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards
- Portable phone charger
- Small backpack/day bag

Luau Experience:
- Hawaiian shirt or tropical attire
- Dress or nice casual outfit
- Comfortable shoes for dancing

Hotel Spa Day:
- Spa-appropriate swimwear
- Robe (if not provided by hotel)
- Personal toiletries

Shopping (Ala Moana Center):
- Comfortable shopping shoes
- Reusable shopping bags

General Items:
- Toiletries (shampoo, conditioner, body wash, etc.)
- Medications and first aid kit
- Insect repellent
- Travel adapter (if needed)
- Books/e-reader for downtime
- Travel pillow and eye mask for flights
- Laundry bag for dirty clothes
- Umbrella or light raincoat (for unexpected showers)

Electronics:
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Headphones
- Laptop/tablet if needed for work
- Power bank

Clothing (consider the 10-day duration):
- T-shirts/tank tops (5-7)
- Shorts (3-4 pairs)
- Lightweight pants or jeans (1-2)
- Dresses/skirts (2-3)
- Sleepwear
- Undergarments
- Socks (minimal needed)
